info.title: An Cu Registration
info.description: Ordinary registration requires a Vietnamese phone contact. Format validation does not verify ownership. Auth0 contact completion is specified in vneid.openapi.json.

post.summary: Create a pending CUSTOMER with email, required Vietnamese phone and local password

201.description: AuthUserResponse, PENDING_VERIFICATION; no session, no verified phone, no caller-selected role

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR, invalid/missing phone, invalid password or unknown fields

csrfHeader.name: X-XSRF-TOKEN
csrfHeader.description: Obtain token and matching cookie from GET /api/v1/auth/csrf

phone.description: Vietnamese mobile 03/05/07/08/09 plus 8 digits, or landline 02 plus 9 digits; equivalent +84 form. Spaces/dots/parentheses/hyphens allowed. Stored as +84; no SMS verification or ownership claim.

password.description: Maximum 72 UTF-8 bytes is enforced server-side
